notes: Glorious Anthem, printed: 'Creatures you control get +1/+1.' It applies to every creature you control, including one whose power is defined by a characteristic-defining ability (CR 613.4: 7a CDA first, then the 7c +1/+1). With one instant in your graveyard, Kinetic Augur (*/4, * = instants and sorceries in your graveyard) enters as 1/4 and the Anthem makes it 2/5. Your plain bear is 3/3; the opponent's bear stays 2/2.
